title: Mobile2U
summary: Online smartphone store with a full storefront, Stripe checkout, PDF e-receipts and a 35-screen admin panel.

contributors.did: Login, registration and logout, the shared site header and layout, and the first version of the admin product pages.

contributors.name: Rest of the team
contributors.did: Product maintenance, cart and checkout, orders and fulfilment, and member and admin tools. Replace with each member's name and module.

problem: A shop selling phones online needs more than a product list: variants and specs, stock that stays correct when two people buy at once, payments, receipts, and staff tools to run it all.
solution: A PHP and MySQL e-commerce site. Customers browse and compare phones, manage a wishlist and addresses, pay through Stripe Checkout, earn reward points, apply vouchers, and get PDF e-receipts by email. Staff get role-based access to 35 admin screens for products, specs, photos, stock, orders, cancellations, reviews and batch CSV import. Stock and order updates run inside database transactions. A security audit added .htaccess protection for .git and database files, fixed an open redirect, and added login blocking and a captcha.
